title: DeepWeave: Weaving Neural and Symbolic Evidence for ML-Based Network Intrusion Detection System
abstract: arXiv:2610.41541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning-based network intrusion detection systems can recognize complex traffic patterns, but often require substantial labelled attack data, degrade under deployment shift, and provide limited evidence for analysts. We present DeepWeave, a probabilistic neuro-symbolic Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) that makes logic an integral part of detection. DeepWeave automatically constructs and validates interpretable rules, represents neural predictions as probabilistic predicates, and reconciles both evidence sources through explicit coupling policies over packet-, flow-, and hybrid-views. The resulting proofs provide intrinsic explanations for rule-supported alerts. Across multiple datasets, DeepWeave improves low-data detection, false-positive control, transferability, and robustness. With only 50 labelled packet observations per attack class, it improves macro-F1 from 0.632 to 0.924 and reduces the attack false-positive

translated_title: DeepWeave：为基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统编织神经与符号证据
translated_abstract: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统能够识别复杂的流量模式，但通常需要大量带标签的攻击数据，在部署环境变化时性能会下降，且能为分析师提供的证据有限。我们提出了DeepWeave，这是一种概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统（NIDS），它将逻辑作为检测的有机组成部分。DeepWeave自动构建并验证可解释的规则，将神经网络预测表示为概率谓词，并通过在数据包视图、流视图和混合视图上的显式耦合策略来协调这两种证据来源。由此产生的证明为规则支持的告警提供了内在的可解释性。在多个数据集上，DeepWeave改善了低数据量检测、误报控制、可迁移性和鲁棒性。每个攻击类别仅需50条带标签的数据包观测，即可将宏平均F1分数从0.632提升至0.924，并降低攻击误报
tldr: DeepWeave是一种概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统，它将自动构建的可解释逻辑规则与神经网络预测在数据包、流和混合视图上进行概率耦合，在极少标注数据下将宏平均F1从0.632提升至0.924，同时增强误报控制、可迁移性和鲁棒性，并提供内在的可解释证明。
en_tdlr: DeepWeave is a probabilistic neuro-symbolic NIDS that weaves automatically constructed interpretable rules with neural predictions through explicit coupling over packet-, flow-, and hybrid-views, boosting macro-F1 from 0.632 to 0.924 with minimal labelled data while improving false-positive control, transferability, robustness, and providing intrinsic explanations.
